key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings yielding acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide attributes for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings provide a process-development reference: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Evaluated four spray parameters at two levels using a reported 24-run full factorial design.
Used ANOVA to quantify parameter contributions to coating properties.
Used Pareto charts to examine spray-parameter interaction effects.
evidence_signal: Coating responses were measured for each experimental run, but the abstract provides no numerical property values or uncertainty estimates.
watch_item: Validate the settings on the intended equipment; the abstract does not establish transferability or report the magnitude of quality improvements.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
